about.title: We help the world find the people who move it
about.subtitle: One trusted place to discover journalists, creators, speakers, experts and public figures, with real numbers and verified owners.
about.mission1: Finding the right voice for a campaign, event or story is slow and full of guesswork. Follower counts are scattered across apps, and it is hard to know who to contact.
about.mission2: We bring it together: clear profiles, transparent reach on every platform, and a simple way to send an inquiry to the talent or their manager.
about.valuesSubtitle: The rules every profile on the platform follows.
about.value1Body: Followers and engagement are shown per platform, and we show where the information came from.
about.value2Body: A person can claim their profile. We confirm it with a code sent to their official account before they can edit it.
about.value3Body: Profiles start from public sources. Anyone can report a mistake or ask for a profile to be removed.
about.value4Body: The whole site works in English, Urdu and Arabic, including right-to-left layouts.
about.forTalent1: Claim your profile and keep your details and numbers correct.
about.forTalent2: Show a verified badge so brands know it is really you.
about.forTalent3: Receive work and speaking inquiries in one place.
about.forBusiness1: Search by profession, industry, topic, city and language.
about.forBusiness2: Compare real reach before you reach out.
about.forBusiness3: Contact the person or their representative directly.
about.faq1Q: Where does the profile information come from?
about.faq1A: From public sources such as official websites and social accounts. After a person claims their profile, they keep it up to date themselves.
about.faq2Q: How do I claim my profile?
about.faq2A: Create a talent account, open your profile and press "Is this you? Claim it". We send a code to one of your official accounts; enter it on your dashboard.
about.faq3Q: What does the verified badge mean?
about.faq3A: It means the profile has been claimed by the real person and confirmed by our team.
about.faq4Q: Something on a profile is wrong. What can I do?
about.faq4A: Open the profile and use "Report an error or request removal". Our team reviews every report.
about.ctaBody: Browse public profiles for free. Create an account to claim your profile or send inquiries.
